summary: This program stores three shopping cart items in separate variables, then joins them into one readable string using the + operator, which combines text values end to end.

lines.text: Each item is stored in its own variable so it can be named and reused later, rather than being typed directly into the print statement.
The + operator joins strings together, and the ", " pieces supply the commas and spaces that separate the items; without them the names would run together.
The same concatenation trick adds a label in front of the finished list, so the output reads as a complete sentence.
